items.text: Chicago acquired DT Jeffery Simmons from Tennessee; GM Ryan Poles expects him to debut Monday.

Chicago (final report): OUT: RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe). QUESTIONABLE: CB Malik Muhammad (toe), LB D'Marco Jackson (ankle). TE Colston Loveland and LB T.J. Edwards have no designation. TE Cole Kmet is on season-ending IR.

Seattle (final report): OUT: LT Charles Cross (ankle; Josh Jones starts), WR Rashid Shaheed (knee), RB Velus Jones Jr. (hamstring). DOUBTFUL: EDGE Uchenna Nwosu (ankle). QUESTIONABLE: backup QB Drew Lock (elbow), G Anthony Bradford (knee), NT Brandon Pili (back), LB Patrick O'Connell (toe). DL Leonard Williams (Achilles) and DT Byron Murphy II (back) have no designation.

Seattle game day: rookie RB Jadarian Price activated from IR and RB Zach Charbonnet (ACL) set for his season debut; RB Robert Henry Jr. released, WR Montorie Foster Jr. and T Bobby Hart elevated. Official inactives not yet posted at time of writing (due ~90 min before kickoff).

adjust.reason: Seattle is without LT Charles Cross, WR Rashid Shaheed and likely EDGE Uchenna Nwosu, while Chicago's main absence is RB Kyle Monangai and it adds DT Jeffery Simmons (Seattle's RB returns partly offset). The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
